patricii.name: Procession
patricii.actionText: Lose your next turn. Player leaves Cart on present Tile and does not move or transact next hour.

patricii.name: Quintus Tineius Clemens
patricii.bio: Senior patrician senator and consul ordinarius of 195 from the distinguished Tineii family, aligned with the old Aurelian order.
patricii.actionText: Sell Falernian at + in C5

patricii.name: Salve!
patricii.actionText: Temporarily receive +1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

patricii.name: Lucius Flavius Philostratus
patricii.bio: Celebrated Athenian sophist at Rome in Julia Domna's literary salon; commissioned by the Empress to write the Life of Apollonius of Tyana.
patricii.actionText: !: Accept the top card of the Missiones deck (unseen) as a Mission.

patricii.name: Decimus Caelius Calvinus Balbinus
patricii.bio: Would serve as consul with Caracalla in 213. Emperor for three months in the Year of the Six Emperors (238).
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Fancy Wine from Market or Deck at < Scarcity

patricii.name: Julia Avita Mamaea
patricii.bio: Niece of Julia Domna. Future empress mother to Alexander Severus.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Fancy Wine at + Scarcity

patricii.name: Ushered Along
patricii.actionText: Move Again. Player must move to an accessible Tile. Cannot complete missions or transact on this Tile before proceeding.

patricii.name: Lucius Fabius Cilo
patricii.bio: Tutor of Caracalla and Geta. Romans were in outcry when soldiers sent to kill Cilo dragged him from his bath through the streets; Caracalla intervened—'Insult not my father, strike not my tutor!'—and had the arresting officer put to death.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Sell the top card of the Goods deck for 14(d) (unless Infl, decide without looking)

patricii.name: Marcus Annius Flavius Libo
patricii.bio: Was Consul in 204. Distant cousin of Marcus Aurelius.
patricii.actionText: Sell Grain at - in B4

patricii.name: Julia Soaemias
patricii.bio: Mother of future emperor Elagabalus. The two were killed by the praetorian guard and discarded in the Tiber River in 222. Niece of Julia Domna.
patricii.actionText: ?: Accept the top card of the Missiones deck (unseen) as a Mission.

patricii.name: Marcus Ulpius Leurus
patricii.bio: Senator during the reign of Caracalla. May have been a Plautilla sympathizer.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Meat Animal at + Scarcity

patricii.name: Quintus Anicius Faustus
patricii.bio: Veteran consular general who built the desert forts of Roman Africa; sidelined in Rome by Caracalla until recalled to govern Asia in 217.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Buffalo in F5 and Deliver to C2

patricii.name: Publius Septimius Geta
patricii.bio: Co-Emperor. Ambushed by Caracalla at a parley on December 26, 211. Died in the arms of their mother, Julia Domna.
patricii.actionText: Sell Marble at -- in C6

patricii.name: Cornificia
patricii.bio: Surviving daughter of Marcus Aurelius. Ordered to take her own life by Caracalla after she wept openly with Julia Domna over the murder of Geta.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Falernian in E6, Deliver to D2

patricii.name: Quintus Tineius Sacerdos
patricii.bio: The apex of his career was serving as consul ordinarius in 219 with Emperor Elagabalus. Aligned with Aurelians.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Animal from Market or Deck at > Scarcity

patricii.name: Lucius Aurelius Commodus Pompeianus
patricii.bio: Caracalla took the precaution of making his murder appear to have been perpetrated by bandits.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Cipollino in F2 and Deliver to B5

patricii.name: Serenus Sammonicus
patricii.bio: Renowned Roman antiquarian, physician-poet, and owner of a 62,000-scroll library; hacked to death at dinner during Caracalla's December 211 purge.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Sell the top card of the Goods deck for 10(d) (unless Infl, decide without looking)

patricii.name: Marcus Nummius Senecio Albinus
patricii.bio: Served as consul in 227. Aligned with the Aurelians.
patricii.actionText: ?: Accept the top card of the Missiones deck (unseen) as a Mission.

patricii.name: Lucius Valerius Messalla Apollinaris
patricii.bio: Thought to have been the son of Thrasea Priscus, but served as consul in 214. Possibly a Plautilla sympathizer.
patricii.actionText: ?: Accept the top card of the Missiones deck (unseen) as a Mission.

patricii.name: Lucius Valerius Messalla Thrasea Priscus
patricii.bio: Patrician senator of ancient Republican lineage and consul ordinarius of 196; executed during Caracalla's purge as a suspected partisan of Geta.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Lion in B3 and Deliver to D5

patricii.name: Julia Maesa
patricii.bio: Julia Domna's older sister. Mother of Julia Soaemias and Julia Avita Mamaea.
patricii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Marble at + Scarcity

patricii.name: Marcus Aurelius Antoninus (Caracalla)
patricii.bio: Senior Co-Emperor — nicknamed Caracalla after the hooded Gallic tunic he popularized. Murdered his brother Geta in December 211.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Oysters in A6 and Deliver to F1 by 5 a.m. next season

patricii.name: Cassius Dio
patricii.bio: Bithynian senator, member of Julia Domna's court circle, and eyewitness historian whose eighty-book Roman History chronicles the terror of 211 A.D. firsthand.
patricii.actionText: Sell Fine Wine in A3 at + Scarcity

patricii.name: Castor
patricii.bio: Devoted imperial chamberlain and confidant of Septimius Severus who tried to restrain Bassianus's plots; ambushed and murdered by Caracalla's henchmen in 211.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Imperial Porphyry in D5 and Deliver to A1

patricii.name: Publius Helvius Pertinax Jr
patricii.bio: Son of the murdered Emperor Pertinax; executed in late 211 after fatally joking that Caracalla should add 'Geticus Maximus' to his victory titles for slaying Geta.
patricii.actionText: Sell Oysters at + in B6

patricii.name: Gaius Julius Avitus Alexianus
patricii.bio: Husband of Julia Maesa and prefect of Italy's imperial child-welfare endowments (praefectus alimentorum) under Caracalla. Loyal to Julia Domna.
patricii.actionText: !: Accept the top card of the Missiones deck (unseen) as a Mission.

patricii.name: Gaius Septimius Severus Aper
patricii.bio: Consul Ordinarius in 207. Executed in late 211 or early 212. Perhaps had been a friend of Geta's.
patricii.actionText: Sell Opimian at + in C5

patricii.name: Aemilius Papinianus
patricii.bio: Celebrated jurist and former Praetorian Prefect close to Julia Domna. When ordered to compose a legal defense for Geta's murder, he refused and was executed with an axe—prompting Caracalla to scold the executioner for not using a sword.
patricii.actionText: Pick up Opimian in C1 and deliver to F2

patricii.name: Brutta Figura
patricii.actionText: Temporarily receive -1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

patricii.name: Julia Domna
patricii.bio: Empress mother of Geta and Caracalla. Committed suicide following Caracalla's assassination in 217.
patricii.actionText: Sell Marble at = in B2

legiones.name: Publius Catius Sabinus
legiones.bio: Intimate supporter of Caracalla. Elagabalus ordered that he be killed, but the centurion mistakenly expelled him from Rome instead.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me (R) x 4(d) (Can give all (d) and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

legiones.name: Publius Cornelius Anulinus
legiones.bio: Would serve as Consul ordinarius in 216, but may have been a Plautilla sympathizer.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Fine Wine (if Player has no Fine W, no demand)

legiones.name: Macrinus
legiones.bio: A seer in Africa declared that Macrinus would seize imperial power. Fearing that he would be put to death over this prophecy, Macrinus conspired to assassinate Caracalla. Emperor from April 217-June 218.
legiones.actionText: Kill the Emperor (Complete if any Player kills either Emperor)

legiones.name: Clodius Pompeianus
legiones.bio: Member of the Claudian Aurelian dynasty. Consul in 241.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me 6(d) (If Player has <6(d), can take thumbs-down and avoid Combat by paying all (d))

legiones.name: Tiberius Claudius Aurelius Quintianus
legiones.bio: Great-grandson of Marcus Aurelius through Lucilla and Pompeianus; served as military tribune and young Aurelian senator under Caracalla before his consulship of 235.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me half of your Cash (give >=50% of all (d) or face Combat)

legiones.name: Vigiles Urbani
legiones.bio: Watchmen of the city. Primarily firefighters. These ones are loyal to Plautilla.
legiones.actionText: !: Give me all of your Grain (if Player has no Grain, no demand)

legiones.name: Centurions
legiones.bio: Roman soldiers. These ones are loyal to Plautilla.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

legiones.name: Praetorian Guard
legiones.bio: The Imperial Guard. These ones are loyal to Geta.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Exotic Animals (Player has no Exotic A, no demand)

legiones.name: Praetorian Guard
legiones.bio: The Imperial Guard. These ones are loyal to Julia Domna.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me your most valuable Item (highest Uncommon Sell Price)

legiones.name: Cohortes Urbanae
legiones.bio: Roman police force used to counterbalance the Praetorian Guard. These ones are loyal to Plautilla.
legiones.actionText: !: Give me 4(d) (If Player has <4(d), receive thumbs-down)

legiones.name: Sextus Varius Marcellus
legiones.bio: Syrian equestrian married to Julia Soaemias and father of future emperor Elagabalus; served in Rome in 211 as acting Prefect (agens vice praefecti) overseeing both the Praetorian and Urban Prefectures.
legiones.actionText: !: Give me 4(d) (If player has <4(d), receive thumbs-down)

legiones.name: Praetorian Guard
legiones.bio: The Imperial Guard. These ones are loyal to Caracalla.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me two Influence Cards (Can give all cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

legiones.name: Quintus Maecius Laetus
legiones.bio: Veteran equestrian commander and Co-Praetorian Prefect of Rome in 211 A.D., appointed alongside Valerius Patruinus at Septimius Severus's deathbed.
legiones.actionText: Sell Weapons at + in A1

legiones.name: Lucius Tiberius Claudius Pompeianus
legiones.bio: Son of Lucius A.C. Pompeianus. Great grandson of Marcus Aurelius. Consul in 231.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Weapons (if Player has no Weapons, no demand)

legiones.name: Gaius Vettius Gratus Sabinianus
legiones.bio: Curator of Via Flaminia. Responsible for Rome's food supply. Plausible Geta supporter.
legiones.actionText: Pick up Rye in B1, Deliver to C4

legiones.name: Legio II Parthica ('The Albanians')
legiones.bio: Septimius Severus's Italian legion stationed just outside Rome at Castra Albana. Fiercely loyal to Geta, they barred their camp gates against Caracalla after Geta's murder until bribed with vast donatives.
legiones.actionText: Pick up Hadrianum in A1 and Deliver to F6

legiones.name: Quintus Virius Egnatius Sulpicius Priscus
legiones.bio: Suffect Consul sometime under Caracalla.
legiones.actionText: Pick up cheapest Marble on Mkt in C3 and deliver to D6. (lowest present Sell Price)

legiones.name: Cohortes Urbanae
legiones.bio: Roman city guard. These ones are loyal to Plautilla.
legiones.actionText: ?: Move again this turn

legiones.name: Gaius Octavius Appius Suetrius Sabinus
legiones.bio: Served under Caracalla. Lived on the Aventine.
legiones.actionText: Pick up priciest Meat A on Mkt in F4 and deliver to B5. (highest present Sell Price) (if no Meat A on Mkt, no mission)

legiones.name: Julius Martialis
legiones.bio: Initial assassin in the murder of Caracalla. Plausibly would have sided with Geta.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me 5(d) (If Player has <5(d), can take thumbs-down and avoid Combat by paying all (d))

legiones.name: Quintus Hedius Lollianus Plautius Avitus
legiones.bio: Consul ordinarius in 209. Not killed by Caracalla.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Wine (if Player has no Wine, no demand)

legiones.name: Titus Flavius Sallustius Paelignianus
legiones.bio: Suffect Consul in 231. Probably a military officer under Caracalla in 211.
legiones.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Marble (if Player has no Marble, no demand)

legiones.name: Lucius Virius Agricola
legiones.bio: Consul ordinarius in 230. Plausibly would have sided with Geta.
legiones.actionText: Pick up priciest Wine on Mkt in C1 and deliver to F2. (highest present Sell Price) (if no Wine on Mkt, no mission)

legiones.name: Nemesianus
legiones.bio: Tribune assigned to the praetorian guard in 217. Pretended to come to Caracalla's rescue after he had been stabbed by Martialis. Instead slew him. Member of the gens Aurelia.
legiones.actionText: !: Give me 3(d) (If player has <3(d), receive thumbs-down)

legiones.name: Marcus Clodius Pupienus Maximus
legiones.bio: Veteran provincial commander under the Severans. Later co-emperor alongside Balbinus for three months in 238, before Praetorians dragged both from the palace and hacked them to death in the streets.
legiones.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Grain from Mkt at > Scarcity

legiones.name: Lucius Virius Lupus Iulianus
legiones.bio: Plautilla sympathizer. Consul in 232.
legiones.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Weapon on Mkt at > Scarcity

legiones.name: Gaius Valerius Patruinus
legiones.bio: Co-Praetorian Prefect in 211 A.D. alongside Maecius Laetus; executed during Caracalla's purge right after Geta's assassination.
legiones.actionText: !: Give me one Wine (If player has no Wine, receive thumbs-down)

legiones.name: Ushered Along
legiones.actionText: Move Again. Player must move to an accessible Tile. Cannot complete missions or transact on this Tile before proceeding.

legiones.name: Marcus Julius Gessius Marcianus
legiones.bio: Married to Julia Mamaea. Father of Severus Alexander. Loyal to Julia Domna.
legiones.actionText: ?: Move again this turn

nefarii.name: Aelius Herodianus
nefarii.bio: Celebrated Alexandrian grammarian in Rome (not to be confused with Herodian the historian), whose treatises on Greek accentuation were prized by Marcus Aurelius and Julia Domna's learned circle.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Marcus Antonius Gordianus
nefarii.bio: Would go on to become Emperor Gordian II. Aurelian aligned. Killed at the Battle of Carthage in 238.
nefarii.actionText: !: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Salve!
nefarii.actionText: Temporarily receive +1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

nefarii.name: Carpophorus
nefarii.bio: Famed Roman bestiarius celebrated for slaying twenty wild beasts in a single arena spectacle; veteran arena hunters still invoke his name in Geta's games.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Animals. (if Player has no Animals, no demand)

nefarii.name: Gaius Sempronius Rufus
nefarii.bio: Notorious eunuch, street poisoner (pharmacopola), and palace informer exiled to an island by Severus, now skulking back into Rome to extort senators for Caracalla.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me 6(d) (Can give all (d) to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Smuggler
nefarii.bio: This procurer of rare goods works for Julia Domna.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell any one Good from Goods Deck at + (relative to Present Mkt Scarcity)

mission.item: Any one Good from Goods Deck

nefarii.name: Maximinus Thrax
nefarii.bio: Towering Thracian recruit of low birth famous for out-wrestling whole cohorts in camp games; later seized the purple in 235 A.D.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Influence Cards (if Player has no Cards, no demand)

nefarii.name: Bato
nefarii.bio: Caracalla commanded Bato to fight three gladiators consecutively, then rewarded him with a magnificent funeral.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Cheap Wine (if Player has no Cheap W, no demand)

nefarii.name: Bulla Felix
nefarii.bio: Legendary 'Robin Hood' bandit captain of 600 brigands who mocked Imperial Prefect Papinian across Italy for two years (205–207 A.D.) before being betrayed by his mistress and thrown to wild beasts.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Fulvius Plautius Hortensianus
nefarii.bio: Son of the executed prefect Plautianus and brother of Fulvia Plautilla; operating covertly with loyalist retainers before Caracalla orders both siblings strangled.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Cash. (if Player has no Cash, no demand)

nefarii.name: Gannys
nefarii.bio: Shrewd household operative raised in the Roman palace of Julia Domna and her sister Julia Maesa, quietly brokering midnight favors for the Syrian imperial women.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Theocritus
nefarii.bio: Former slave and Roman pantomime dancer who taught Bassianus to dance, leveraging imperial favor to corner provisions and shake down night merchants.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Marble from Mkt at > Scarcity

nefarii.name: Tiberius Clodius Pupienus Pulcher Maximus
nefarii.bio: Consul suffectus in 224. Plausibly would have sided with Geta.
nefarii.actionText: Pick up cheapest Wine on Mkt in F6 and deliver to E3. (highest present Sell Price) (if no Wine on Mkt, no mission)

nefarii.name: Serapion
nefarii.bio: Underground Egyptian astrologer (mathematicus) plying forbidden horoscopes in Rome's dark alleys—whispering prophecies that Caracalla's reign will end in blood.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Subura Cutthroat
nefarii.bio: Hired blade from the pitch-black tenements of the Subura, retained secretly by anxious Aurelian senators to settle scores and intercept midnight couriers.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Euprepes
nefarii.bio: Celebrated Roman charioteer who crowned 782 Circus victories—marked for death by Caracalla solely because he raced for the rival faction cheered by Geta.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Brutta Figura
nefarii.actionText: Temporarily receive -1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

nefarii.name: Suppositicius
nefarii.bio: Fresh arena substitute gladiator thrown in against an exhausted Bato during Caracalla's rigged spectacle; Geta's partisans backed him out of spite.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Meat Animals (if Player has no Meat A, no demand)

nefarii.name: Fulvia Plautilla
nefarii.bio: Estranged wife of Caracalla. Though officially banished to the island of Lipara on paper after her father Plautianus's execution, street rumor holds she has slipped back into Rome by night in disguise to conspire against the regime.
nefarii.actionText: Pick up Pugiones in A5 and deliver to D5

nefarii.name: Coeranus
nefarii.bio: Egyptian equestrian confidant of Plautianus exiled to an island in 205 A.D.; maneuvering in the shadows until Caracalla recalled him in 212 as Rome's first Egyptian senator.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Flamma
nefarii.bio: Legendary Syrian secutor recorded on his Sicilian tombstone (CIL X 7297): fought 34 bouts, won 21, refused the wooden rudis of freedom four times, and died in the arena at age 30 in the 2nd century—still idolized by Geta's arena-mad partisans.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Wine (if Player has no Wine, no demand)

nefarii.name: Euodus
nefarii.bio: Conniving imperial freedman and childhood tutor to Bassianus who engineered the deadly palace trap against Plautianus—before Caracalla had him executed too in late 211.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Exotic A from Mkt at > Scarcity

nefarii.name: Lupanar Procurer
nefarii.bio: Nighttime brothel-keeper under the arches of the Circus Maximus who trades patrician secrets and demands fine stone for Plautilla's covert safe-houses.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Marble (if Player has no Marble, no demand)

nefarii.name: Saturninus
nefarii.bio: Syrian nocturnal courier entangled in the fall of Plautianus's household, fencing fine vintages through back-alley taverns to finance exiled conspirators.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Wine at = Scarcity

nefarii.name: Herodian Of Antioch
nefarii.bio: Minor imperial freedman-clerk in 211 Rome whose sharp nighttime observations of the brothers' divided palace Guard would fill Book IV of his Roman History.
nefarii.actionText: !: Give me all of your Fine Wine (if Player has no Fine W, no demand)

nefarii.name: Epagathus
nefarii.bio: Ruthless imperial freedman and palace enforcer operating at night between the Palatine and Praetorian camp, shaking down passing carts for hush money.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me 4(d) (Can give all (d) to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Emporium Dock-Thief
nefarii.bio: Riverfront smuggling gang operating along the Tiber warehouses below Mons Testaceus, fencing wine amphorae to fund Plautilla's underground network.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Wine at = Scarcity

nefarii.name: Poacher
nefarii.bio: This one works for Julia Domna.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Exotic A from Mkt at > Scarcity
